text: DSH Devwork 是面向 DSH Web 会话的任务式开发工作区。它把任务树、主 Session 与重试记录关联起来，在 Host 持久化任务状态，并在会话界面展示进度、验收证据、Artifacts 和 PR/MR 交付。可通过注入的规划器、Session 与 Agent provider 创建并执行任务，也可接入 GitHub 或 GitLab 交付 provider。适合希望在同一会话中跟踪编码任务、审查与交付的开发者；需由宿主提供存储及相应 provider，缺少配置时任务源会显示不可用。

DSH Devwork organizes coding work into tasks linked to primary Sessions and retries. Its Host persists state; a conversation panel shows progress, acceptance evidence, artifacts, and PR/MR delivery. Injected providers handle planning, Sessions, Agents, and optional GitHub or GitLab delivery.

我想在聊天界面查看任务状态、验收条件和产物。

Can I follow task progress, artifacts, and pull request reviews from the conversation?
DSH Devwork 的功能「任务分解」：将带目标、范围、验收条件和依赖的嵌套任务定义校验后，按稳定顺序登记为父子任务，并为每项关联主 Session。
DSH Devwork 的功能「Session 与执行记录」：通过注入的 Session 和 Agent provider 创建任务会话、执行单项任务，并把成功、暂停、阻塞、失败或取消结果记录为尝试状态。
DSH Devwork 的功能「会话任务面板」：在 DSH 会话视图挂载任务面板，按选中 Session 提供共享的任务投影，可查看状态、进度、验收、Artifact 和 PR/MR 信息。
DSH Devwork 的功能「交付跟踪」：记录 Artifact，并通过配置的 GitHub 或 GitLab provider 创建或同步 PR/MR 状态、检查与审查信息。
DSH Devwork 的功能「持久化任务状态」：Host 可使用文件事件日志存储任务变更，重开后从日志恢复投影；恢复数据不会自动重启 Agent 执行。
我希望为每个开发任务记录验收标准、依赖和工作目录。
I need a durable task log that restores task state when the Host reopens.

@guosheng_047/dsh-devwork README · DSH Devwork：English | [中文](README.zh.md)

A task-centered desktop development workspace built on [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness). Define work as tasks, follow their Session tree, and inspect acceptance evidence, Artifacts and PR/MR delivery from the same conversation.

@guosheng_047/dsh-devwork README · DSH Devwork：**Status: the task-center Host bridge is implemented with mock coverage; native desktop acceptance remains open.** `TaskPanelHost` owns the durable task projection, execution engine and delivery service, and exposes one Session-scoped `taskPanelSource` to the Client panel. Provider and planner dependencies are explicit: without them the source reports `unavailable` instead of creating mock state. Mock tests describe deterministic service behavior and do not claim real desktop, provider or model acceptance. No npm release has been published.

@guosheng_047/dsh-devwork README · Product model：- A task is the durable unit of work and has one primary Session.
- Parent and child tasks form the Session tree; retries create Attempts under the same Session.
- Acceptance criteria, execution results, Artifacts, workspace leases and PR/MR integrations have independent persisted state.
- Merge requires a current, user-authorized handoff. Cleanup runs only after ownership, delivery, acceptance and workspace checks succeed.
- The Host owns task state. Client views subscribe to the same projection and do not create a second store.
- The first phase uses one active executor. Remote execution, mobile clients, email and automatic crash recovery remain outside the product boundary.

@guosheng_047/dsh-devwork README · Product model：The old Round/Leader POC entry points, data model and compatibility layer have been removed. This alpha is a breaking task-center transition; consumers must use the public task-center APIs.

See the [task-center domain model](docs/task-center.md) for the persisted states and Host/Client boundary.

@guosheng_047/dsh-devwork README · Develop and try the bundle：Baseline: DSH **0.2.1-alpha.2**, Cordis **4.0.5-alpha.1**. Use **Node.js 24.x only** and **pnpm 12.11.2**. Source and development scripts use strict TypeScript 7.0.2.

```sh
git clone https://github.com/GuoMonth/dsh-devwork.git
cd dsh-devwork
pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
pnpm run verify

@guosheng_047/dsh-devwork README · Develop and try the bundle：In the DSH desktop Plugins page, install the local package directory and enable Devwork. The Client entry inserts an editable task request and never submits it automatically. The Host must supply a task repository plus explicit Session/Agent providers before creation and execution are available; a missing configuration remains visibly unavailable.

For CLI package validation with an installed DSH CLI, from the directory above the checkout:

@guosheng_047/dsh-devwork README · Develop and try the bundle：```sh
dsh plugin --profile devwork-demo add ./dsh-devwork
dsh --profile devwork-demo --dump-config
```

The output should include the Devwork bundle layer and the `guomonth-devwork` row. This profile checks installation metadata; it is not a separate desktop application.

@guosheng_047/dsh-devwork README · Develop and try the bundle：The test suite covers task state transitions, Session-scoped Host actions, execution cancellation, durable Artifact and delivery state, cleanup guards, Client registration and panel rendering without a browser. Real provider calls, permission UI, model judgment and native desktop interaction remain final E2E work.

@guosheng_047/dsh-devwork README · Package and release：Package: `@guosheng_047/dsh-devwork`. It is a DSH **bundle** with `dsh.bundle.patch`, not a profile. Shared Host APIs are peers; built JavaScript, declarations, patch, icon and locales are included in the npm tarball.

See [release instructions](docs/releasing.md) and [contributing](CONTRIBUTING.md). Publishing and tagging require an explicit maintainer request.
